result.keyword: What's the best password manager for a small team?
result.markdown:
For most small teams, I'd recommend **1Password or Bitwarden**\.

My overall pick is 1Password if ease of use and team management matter most. Bitwarden is the better choice if you want excellent security at a lower price.

## My top 4 recommendations

![Reseña de 1Password (2026) — Pros, contras y calificación](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/LhhWUKpIQMTSXlgy0rkrwkHAERgLjZW5NCI0Xc0qkbUSpwWTzEsJW5e71Kaq5cpXXWizPt5ktnTq8wPiR_oY_whlI1wTSXpy9Y6q6L9PQ5B5-G7e3wkG3IEdQWVwR8XRay6DBOKXCTQbQylBaZFlaPEM9QThG5K5RPgmWiXTqGFDVXlTrr7B7oW9lYa2JiZP?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. 1Password Business**

(Best overall)

- Excellent user experience.
- Shared vaults and granular permissions.
- Strong admin controls and reporting.
- Good for teams without dedicated IT staff.

Business: approximately \$8.99/user/month. Teams Starter Pack: \$24.95/month for up to 10 users.

[1Password business plans](https://1password.com/business)

---

![Test Bitwarden Premium - Gestionnaire de mots de passe - Que Choisir Ensemble](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/hC5M3yQmIFKAAlHcnKpChWSt35-xr8mlIVRywSu-o8DpkerDwLMFxvrII2QFuvOsSP0k6Fo_mQuwr7t8sXrBNPDXf_LEbep8cD4z2PlCIIwWjH4OqBMrEZ0-9cp7BChiCyWOBI7Pq7evrJY8TBbAUMof-Y5H7s49GfDyBJKLiGrh0gHLhDv6TMbIv6ti_DVz?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Bitwarden Teams**

(Best value)

- Open-source foundations.
- Secure shared collections.
- Admin and audit features.
- Self-hosting available with Enterprise.

Teams: approximately \$4/user/month.

[Bitwarden business plans](https://bitwarden.com/business/)

---

![Keeper Security Logo PNG,  Vector (AI, EPS, CDR, PDF, SVG) - iconLogoVector](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/hjZLLtGaZjkKvsDiCoIrNA749yx3vMYIFoRmmV0blB-pAj7O30nu3RJOVVhVRwgAOkJUfJ3datZ7pfH1wp7yeplrEL3FQ-HNOpCzlVOW0OcMr1CFjIFAx50apRkdH6sYOH31WcP6gfXOxeAN8qubYhHhGYA5yXp1bc7wqtCxjN2WEQuyMALTG1Pwne14BXyG?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Keeper**

- Strong administrative controls.
- Shared team folders.
- Good role-based access management.
- Particularly useful for security-conscious businesses.

Business Starter advertised from approximately \$2/user/month.

[Keeper business plans](https://www.keepersecurity.com/business.html)

---

![Test Proton Pass Plus - Gestionnaire de mots de passe - Que Choisir Ensemble](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/ieWxaf1V1oKwR5RRYZyCUPTssuPFmf3KGImAFxDImLo918b9HrqSkmcFxYOmTtZlPSYlBfMDN2fRfrT9cxgSPcskegAU9CMbarL_OHz9CIE3qqDdr6RF19eJVNxO2Ol4ntEKr3D7ZAQzGf8y8YfFA_bGj9p5D2RwqWU6uGCUEvGwoAX0vUa7O4BZUHkNpExF?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Proton Pass**

- Privacy-focused approach.
- Encrypted password sharing.
- Useful email alias features.
- Worth considering for privacy-conscious teams.

Business plans from approximately \$2/user/month, depending on tier.

[Proton Pass business plans](https://proton.me/business/pass)

Prices are indicative USD prices based on published 2026 comparisons, generally with annual billing. Check current regional pricing and plan features before purchasing. [toolsandthrive.com](https://toolsandthrive.com/best-password-manager-for-small-business/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.softwarecompare.net](https://www.softwarecompare.net/comparison/best-password-manager-for-business?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.openideurope.eu](https://www.openideurope.eu/reviews/password-managers-for-business/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## What I'd prioritise

Whichever you choose, make sure it supports\:

- Shared vaults with individual permissions.
- Two-factor authentication (2FA).
- Admin control over employee accounts.
- Immediate access revocation when someone leaves.
- Secure password sharing without sending passwords through email or Slack.
- Audit logs and account recovery.

## A couple of questions to narrow it down

I can give you a much more specific recommendation with two details\:

**1\. How many people are in your team?**

- 2–5
- 6–10
- 11–25
- 26–50
- 50+

**2\. What matters most?**

- Lowest possible cost.
- Best security.
- Easiest for non-technical staff.
- Best admin controls and shared access.
- A good balance of everything.

My starting recommendation would be **1Password for simplicity or Bitwarden for value**\.
